_doc: Growth-guard policy: the LIVE production `pipeline_setting` rows grow.guard.* and grow.input.* of the source fleet, exported READ-ONLY from var/pipeline.db on 2026-10-06 (query: SELECT key,value FROM pipeline_setting WHERE key LIKE 'grow.guard.%' OR key LIKE 'grow.input.%'). Keys are the fleet's own, applied through the unmodified growth_guard.policy_from_db() code path. Any GuardPolicy field NOT listed here takes its dataclass default (see cloud_grow/growth_guard.py). UNVALIDATED against human annotation (D6): see README.

_cloud_notes.overlap: GuardPolicy.overlap defaults True but needs the hub's neighbour feed (cover); with cover=None the criterion is SKIPPED (announced in the round summary), as on a peer without the feed.
_cloud_notes.flatten_feedback: reads flatten attempts; none exist on a cloud box, so it is inert (checked=0).
_cloud_notes.selfcross_fail_closed: dataclass default True; NOT overridden. A round whose selfx check cannot run is held back and the grow pauses.
_cloud_notes.merge_pause: 0 in production; needs the hub neighbour feed.
